card.name: Punctuation inside drug lists and citations
card.fires_on: Commas after a drug name in example lists, and a few spots right after a drug or reference phrase such as a space before page numbers. Mostly in drug-interaction lists and reference entries.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma right after a drug name in a list of examples, before the next drug.
modes.example: certain muscle relaxants (i.e., cyclobenzaprine<<,>> metaxalone), monoamine oxidase

modes.label: Citation spacing
modes.description: The space before page numbers in a journal reference.
modes.example: . B., Desper, J, Co-crystal screening of diclofenac, Pharmaceutics 2011, 3,<< >>601-614.

modes.label: Inside drug-class term
modes.description: The end of a drug class word or a small word after a drug name in a heading or trial sentence.

card.plain: It marks the comma or break right after a drug name in lists of example drugs and in references.
